title: Artifact (v1)
description: One representation or file belonging to a Source — a canonical pipeline file, an immutable raw evidence file, or a remote medium such as a YouTube video. Canvas plan §10.2. An artifact that does not exist locally is reported as unavailable; a missing artifact is never masked with a placeholder or fabricated data (canvas plan §15).

id.description: Three-part global id, local part naming the artifact — e.g. youtube:pqlWNihgdjI:transcript.

kind.description: What the artifact is. Grounded in the files the pipeline actually writes plus the media types planned for later phases.

role.description: Storage tier and mutability class. 'raw' is immutable evidence under output/<id>/raw/. 'canonical' is pipeline output under output/<id>/. 'work' is intermediate pipeline scratch. 'export' is a generated view such as a vault note. 'external' has no local file — it lives at a URL.

media_type.description: IANA media type when known; null rather than a guess.

path.description: Project-relative path, or null for an external artifact. Never an absolute host path (risk R15).

url.description: Remote location, or null. For a YouTube video this is the watch URL: there is no local media file and the UI must never assume one exists.

sha256.description: Content hash from io.sha256_file, used for incremental indexing. Null when not hashed or not local.

immutable.description: True for every artifact with role 'raw'. Nothing in the UI or API may write to an immutable artifact (ADR 0001 invariant 1).

available.description: Whether the artifact was present at index time. False is displayed honestly as missing.

allOf.description: An artifact must be locatable: a local path, a remote URL, or both.
